  "content": "\"\"\"Reproducible material-property diagnostics; IAPWS95 water substitution, NOT Hill.\n\nNo rigorous interval certificate, experiment, or timing recommendation is produced.\nPytzer interaction functions below are loaded from retained inspected source; its\nGNU GPLv3 notice remains in that file. Dependencies: click, scipy, mpmath, iapws.\n\"\"\"\nimport ast\nfrom functools import lru_cache\nimport hashlib\nimport importlib.metadata\nimport json\nimport math\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport click\nimport mpmath as mp\nfrom scipy.interpolate import CubicSpline\nfrom scipy.integrate import quad\nfrom scipy.optimize import brentq\nfrom iapws import IAPWS95\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent\nmp.mp.dps = 45\nRG = 8.31451\nMR = 6.0\nP_MPA = 0.1\nTR = 298.15\nTS = 293.15\nNACL = 10 / 58.443\nMWATER = .99820675\nM = NACL / MWATER\nWATER = IAPWS95()\n\n\ndef retained_functions(filename, names):\n    source = (ROOT / filename).read_text()\n    module = ast.parse(source)\n    selected = [n for n in module.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name in names]\n    assert {n.name for n in selected} == set(names)\n    namespace = {}\n    exec(compile(ast.Module(selected, []), filename, 'exec'), namespace)\n    return namespace\n\n\nPARAMS = retained_functions('pytzer-parameters.py', ['A92ii_eq36', 'bC_Na_Cl_A92ii'])\n\n\n@lru_cache(maxsize=20000)\ndef liquid(T):\n    \"\"\"Keep the high-density water branch even above its saturation temperature.\"\"\"\n    rho = brentq(lambda r: WATER._Helmholtz(r, T)['P'] - P_MPA * 1000,\n                 900., 1100., xtol=1e-10)\n    v = WATER._Helmholtz(rho, T)\n    delta, tau = rho / WATER.rhoc, WATER.Tc / T\n    p0 = WATER._phi0(tau, delta)\n    pr = WATER._phir(tau, delta)\n    cv = -WATER.R * tau**2 * (p0['fiott'] + pr['firtt'])\n    cp = cv + WATER.R * (1 + delta*pr['fird'] - delta*tau*pr['firdt'])**2 / (\n        1 + 2*delta*pr['fird'] + delta**2*pr['firdd'])\n    return {'rho': rho, 'h_J_kg': float(v['h'])*1000,\n            's_J_kgK': float(v['s'])*1000, 'cp_J_kgK': float(cp)*1000}\n\n\ndef aphi(T):\n    \"\"\"AW90 dielectric/DH algorithm, with IAPWS95 density instead of Hill.\"\"\"\n    rho = liquid(float(T))['rho'] / 1000\n    p = P_MPA\n    b = [-.04044525, 103.6180, 75.32165, -23.23778, -3.548184,\n         -1246.311, 263307.7, -.6928953, -204.4473]\n    gm = (b[0]*p/T + b[1]/math.sqrt(T) + b[2]/(T-215)\n          + b[3]/math.sqrt(T-215) + b[4]/(T-215)**.25\n          + math.exp(b[5]/T+b[6]/T**2+b[7]*p/T+b[8]*p/T**2))\n    g = gm*rho+1\n    aa = (1.444e-24 + g*(1.84e-18)**2/(3*1.380658e-16*T)) * 4*math.pi*6.0221367e23*rho/(3*18.0153)\n    dielectric = (1+9*aa+3*math.sqrt(9*aa*aa+2*aa+1))/4\n    return math.sqrt(2e-3*math.pi*rho*6.0221367e23) * (\n        100*(1.6021773e-19)**2/(4*math.pi*dielectric*8.8541878e-12*1.380658e-23*T))**1.5/3\n\n\ndef aphi_derivatives(T, step):\n    x0, xm, xp = aphi(T), aphi(T-step), aphi(T+step)\n    xmm, xpp = aphi(T-2*step), aphi(T+2*step)\n    return ((xmm-8*xm+8*xp-xpp)/(12*step),\n            (-xpp+16*xp-30*x0+16*xm-xmm)/(12*step**2))\n\n\n@lru_cache(maxsize=10000)\ndef bc(T):\n    vals = PARAMS['bC_Na_Cl_A92ii'](mp.mpf(T), 10)\n    return tuple(vals[i] for i in [0, 1, 3, 4])\n\n\ndef factors(m):\n    x, y = 2*math.sqrt(m), 2.5*math.sqrt(m)\n    return (2*(1-(1+x)*math.exp(-x))/x**2,\n            4*(6-(6+6*y+3*y*y+y**3)*math.exp(-y))/y**4)\n\n\ndef interaction_derivatives(T, m):\n    gb, gc = factors(m)\n    first = [float(mp.diff(lambda u: bc(u)[i], mp.mpf(T))) for i in range(4)]\n    second = [float(mp.diff(lambda u: bc(u)[i], mp.mpf(T), 2)) for i in range(4)]\n    bt, ct = first[0]+gb*first[1], first[2]+gc*first[3]\n    btt, ctt = second[0]+gb*second[1], second[2]+gc*second[3]\n    return bt, ct, btt+2*bt/T, ctt+2*ct/T\n\n\ndef lphi(T, m=M, step=.05):\n    da, _ = aphi_derivatives(T, step)\n    bt, ct, _, _ = interaction_derivatives(T, m)\n    return (4*RG*T*T*da*math.log1p(1.2*math.sqrt(m))/1.2\n            - 2*RG*T*T*(m*bt+m*m*ct))\n\n\ndef cp_ref(T):\n    return 1000*(1.62690371649145-.767143070769565*T/300\n                 + .211473310430416*(T/300)**2-1.00267947284134*100/T)\n\n\ndef h_ref_primitive(T):\n    return 1000*(1.62690371649145*T-.767143070769565*T*T/600\n                 + .211473310430416*T**3/270000-1.00267947284134*100*math.log(T))\n\n\ndef capp(T, m=M, step=.05):\n    da, daa = aphi_derivatives(T, step)\n    ac = 4*RG*(2*T*da+T*T*daa)\n    _, _, bm, cm = interaction_derivatives(T, m)\n    _, _, br, cr = interaction_derivatives(T, MR)\n    return (cp_ref(T)-liquid(T)['cp_J_kgK']/MR\n            + ac/1.2*math.log((1+1.2*math.sqrt(m))/(1+1.2*math.sqrt(MR)))\n            - 2*RG*T*T*(m*bm-MR*br+m*m*cm-MR*MR*cr))\n\n\nKNOTS = [0,5,7.5,15,20,45,90,220,400,550,800,1100]\nKVALUES = [20.4174,18.6946,18.2037,15.2827,13.2900,8.12535,5.77101,\n           5.62745,7.04825,7.41175,5.08930,-8.76890]\nSPLINE = CubicSpline(KNOTS, KVALUES, bc_type='natural')\n\n\ndef cp_cr(T):\n    return float((T/(SPLINE(T)+.25*T))**3)\n\n\nSOLID_INCREMENT = quad(cp_cr, TS, TR, epsabs=1e-9)[0]\nHINF = -9040.721+TR*(115.5108-72.2653)\n\n\ndef stored_solid_difference(T, m=M, step=.05):\n    dh = (h_ref_primitive(T)-h_ref_primitive(TR)\n          - (liquid(T)['h_J_kg']-liquid(TR)['h_J_kg'])/MR\n          + lphi(T,m,step)-lphi(T,MR,step)-lphi(TR,m,step)+lphi(TR,MR,step))\n    return HINF+lphi(TR,m,step)+SOLID_INCREMENT+dh\n\n\ndef osmotic(T,m=M):\n    b0,b1,c0,c1=map(float,bc(T))\n    return (1-aphi(T)*math.sqrt(m)/(1+1.2*math.sqrt(m))\n            +m*(b0+b1*math.exp(-2*math.sqrt(m)))\n            +2*m*m*(c0+c1*math.exp(-2.5*math.sqrt(m))))\n\n\ndef phase_difference(T,m):\n    liq=liquid(T)\n    rv=brentq(lambda r:WATER._Helmholtz(r,T)['P']-P_MPA*1000,.3,1.5)\n    vap=WATER._Helmholtz(rv,T)\n    gdiff=(float(vap['h'])*1000-T*float(vap['s'])*1000\n           -liq['h_J_kg']+T*liq['s_J_kgK'])\n    logaw=-2*.0180153*m*osmotic(T,m) if m else 0.\n    return gdiff-WATER.R*1000*T*logaw\n\n\n@click.command()\n@click.option('--out',type=click.Path(path_type=Path),required=True)\ndef main(out):\n    rows=[]\n    for celsius in [19,20,25,60,100]:\n        T=celsius+273.15\n        row={'temperature_C':celsius,'water':liquid(T),'solid_cp_J_molK':cp_cr(T),'Aphi':aphi(T)}\n        row['step_diagnostics']=[{'finite_difference_step_K':h,'Capp_J_molK':capp(T,step=h),'d_J_mol':stored_solid_difference(T,step=h)} for h in [.1,.05,.025]]\n        rows.append(row)\n        click.echo(json.dumps(row),err=True)\n    coding=[]\n    for T,expected in [(273,[.06542,.2265,.001304,-.06719]),(298,[.08055,.2630,.0002682,-.01022]),(323,[.09139,.2826,-.0005856,.00639]),(373,[.1008,.3218,-.001725,.01267])]:\n        coding.append({'temperature_K':T,'Archer_table7':expected,'corrected_Pytzer_parameters':list(map(float,bc(T)))})\n    phases={'water_boil_C':brentq(lambda T:phase_difference(T,0),368,378)-273.15,\n   "content": "import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Deriv\nimport Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.MeanValue\nimport Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith\nimport Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp\nimport Mathlib.Tactic.Ring\n\n/- Supplied starting temperature in degrees Celsius. -/\ndef initialTemperature : ℝ := 20\n\n/- Constant heater input W, room temperature A, linear heat-loss\n   coefficient k. This SAME law applies to water and brine (watts). -/\ndef netPower (W k A T : ℝ) : ℝ := W - k * (T - A)\n\n/- Instantaneous conservation of energy on adding salt: C is water+pot\n   capacity, S = final solution capacity minus original water capacity (signed),\n   Ts salt temperature and enthalpy reference, H dissolution energy at Ts. Capacities J/K, H joules. -/\nnoncomputable def mixedTemperature (C S H Ts x : ℝ) : ℝ :=\n  (C * x + S * Ts - H) / (C + S)\n\n/- Integrated inverse energy balance dt/dT = capacity/netPower(T).\n   Used only where net power is positive and k>0. -/\nnoncomputable def heatingTime (capacity W k A u v : ℝ) : ℝ :=\n  capacity / k * (Real.log (netPower W k A u) - Real.log (netPower W k A v))\n\n/- Total seconds to a fixed final solution boiling temperature B when\n   salt is added at unsalted temperature x. The mixing temperature jump and the\n   changed heat capacity are both included. -/\nnoncomputable def boilingTime (C S H Ts B W k A x : ℝ) : ℝ :=\n  heatingTime C W k A initialTemperature x +\n  heatingTime (C + S) W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) B\n\n/- H is the isothermal dissolution energy at Ts, not at every x.\n   If cs is solid salt capacity, Kirchhoff gives dissolution energy\n   H+(S-cs)*(x-Ts) at x. Warming the solid to x costs cs*(x-Ts).\n   Thus their sum is H+S*(x-Ts), for either sign of S. -/\nlemma reference_consistent_balance :\n    ∀ (C S H Ts cs x z : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 →\n    ((C + S) * (z - x) + cs * (x - Ts) +\n      (H + (S - cs) * (x - Ts)) = 0 ↔\n      z = mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) := by\n  intro C S H Ts cs x z hc\n  unfold mixedTemperature\n  rw [eq_div_iff hc]\n  constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith\n\n/- Derived conservation of enthalpy; no presumed mixing-temperature sign. -/\nlemma mixing_balance :\n    ∀ (C S H Ts x : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 →\n    (C + S) * mixedTemperature C S H Ts x = C * x + S * Ts - H := by\n  intro C S H Ts x hc\n  unfold mixedTemperature\n  field_simp\n\n/- Derive the net-power jump from energy conservation AND the shared\n   heat-transfer law; before/after powers are not independent parameters. -/\nlemma power_change :\n    ∀ (C S H Ts W k A x : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 →\n    netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) - netPower W k A x =\n      k * (S * (x - Ts) + H) / (C + S) := by\n  intro C S H Ts W k A x hc\n  unfold netPower mixedTemperature\n  field_simp\n  ring\n\nlemma power_derivative :\n    ∀ (W k A x : ℝ), HasDerivAt (netPower W k A) (-k) x := by\n  intro W k A x\n  unfold netPower\n  convert (((hasDerivAt_id x).sub_const A).const_mul k).const_sub W using 1 <;> simp\n\n/- Checks the integrated heating law against the differential first law:\n   increasing endpoint temperature costs capacity/netPower seconds/K. -/\nlemma heating_time_derivative :\n    ∀ (capacity W k A u v : ℝ), k ≠ 0 → netPower W k A v ≠ 0 →\n    HasDerivAt (fun y => heatingTime capacity W k A u y)\n      (capacity / netPower W k A v) v := by\n  intro capacity W k A u v hk hv\n  have h := (((power_derivative W k A v).log hv).const_sub\n    (Real.log (netPower W k A u))).const_mul (capacity / k)\n  unfold heatingTime\n  convert h using 1\n  field_simp [hk, hv]\n\n/- Derivation of the stage-time formula from the inverse first law.\n   For any elapsed-time curve f with df/dT = capacity/netPower and f(u)=0,\n   the endpoint time MUST equal heatingTime; it is not a fitted formula.\n   Endpoint derivatives may be read as those of a smooth local extension. -/\nlemma stage_time_from_energy :\n    ∀ (capacity W k A u v : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ),\n    u ≤ v → k ≠ 0 →\n    (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, 0 < netPower W k A y) →\n    (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, HasDerivAt f (capacity / netPower W k A y) y) →\n    f u = 0 → f v = heatingTime capacity W k A u v := by\n  intro capacity W k A u v f huv hk hp hf hu\n  have mono : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ),\n      (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, HasDerivAt g 0 y) → MonotoneOn g (Set.Icc u v) := by\n    intro g hg\n    apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Icc _ _)\n    · intro y hy\n      exact (hg y hy).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt\n    · intro y hy\n      exact (hg y (interior_subset hy)).hasDerivWithinAt\n    · intro y hy\n      exact le_refl 0\n  have hd : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v,\n      HasDerivAt (fun w => f w - heatingTime capacity W k A u w) 0 y := by\n    intro y hy\n    have hh := heating_time_derivative capacity W k A u y hk (ne_of_gt (hp y hy))\n    convert (hf y hy).sub hh using 1 <;> simp\n  have hm := mono (fun w => f w - heatingTime capacity W k A u w) hd\n  have hn := mono (fun w => -(f w - heatingTime capacity W k A u w)) (by\n    intro y hy\n    convert (hd y hy).neg using 1 <;> simp)\n  have hle := hm ⟨le_refl u, huv⟩ ⟨huv, le_refl v⟩ huv\n  have hge := hn ⟨le_refl u, huv⟩ ⟨huv, le_refl v⟩ huv\n  have hzero : heatingTime capacity W k A u u = 0 := by\n    simp only [heatingTime, sub_self, mul_zero]\n  linarith\n\n/- Eliminate the two heating stages. The derivative compares the time\n   spent heating unsalted water with the time saved in the salted stage. -/\nlemma boiling_time_derivative :\n    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A x : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 → k ≠ 0 →\n    netPower W k A x ≠ 0 →\n    netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) ≠ 0 →\n    HasDerivAt (boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A)\n      (C / netPower W k A x -\n       C / netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x)) x := by\n  intro C S H Ts B W k A x hc hk hx hz\n  have hm : HasDerivAt (mixedTemperature C S H Ts) (C / (C + S)) x := by\n    unfold mixedTemperature\n    convert ((((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul C).add_const (S * Ts)).sub_const H).div_const\n      (C + S) using 1 <;> simp\n  have hn := (power_derivative W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x)).comp x hm\n  have hpost := (((hn.log hz).sub_const\n    (Real.log (netPower W k A B))).const_mul ((C + S) / k))\n  have hpre := heating_time_derivative C W k A initialTemperature x hk hx\n  convert hpre.add hpost using 1\n  · rfl\n  · dsimp only [Function.comp_apply]\n    field_simp [hc, hk, hx, hz]\n    ring\n\n/- The derivative has precisely the sign of the net cooling energy\n   D(x)=S*(x-Ts)+H when capacities and net powers are positive. -/\nlemma timing_derivative_signed :\n    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A x : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 → k ≠ 0 →\n    netPower W k A x ≠ 0 →\n    netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) ≠ 0 →\n    HasDerivAt (boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A)\n      (C * (k * (S * (x - Ts) + H) / (C + S)) /\n        (netPower W k A x * netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x))) x := by\n  intro C S H Ts B W k A x hc hk hx hz\n  have hj := power_change C S H Ts W k A x hc\n  have he : C / netPower W k A x - C / netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) =\n      C * (k * (S * (x - Ts) + H) / (C + S)) /\n        (netPower W k A x * netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x)) := by\n    rw [← hj]\n    field_simp\n    <;> ring\n  rw [← he]\n  exact boiling_time_derivative C S H Ts B W k A x hc hk hx hz\n\n/- Constant-capacity mixing is increasing in the addition temperature,\n   even if S<0. Endpoint constraints keep the entire trajectory liquid.\n   F is a common liquid lower bound; B0 is unsalted boiling temperature. -/\nlemma feasible_trajectory :\n    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A F B0 L U y : ℝ),\n    0 < C → 0 < C + S → 0 < k →\n    F ≤ initialTemperature → initialTemperature ≤ L → L ≤ U → U ≤ B0 →\n    F ≤ mixedTemperature C S H Ts L → mixedTemperature C S H Ts U ≤ B →\n    0 < netPower W k A U → 0 < netPower W k A B →\n    y ∈ Set.Icc L U →\n    (initialTemperature ≤ y ∧ y ≤ B0) ∧\n    (F ≤ mixedTemperature C S H Ts y ∧ mixedTemperature C S H Ts y ≤ B) ∧\n    (0 < netPower W k A y ∧ 0 < netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts y)) := by\n  intro C S H Ts B W k A F B0 L U y hC hc hk hF hi hLU hU hzl hzu hpU hpB hy\n  have hzmono : Monotone (mixedTemperature C S H Ts) := by\n    intro a b hab\n    unfold mixedTemperature\n    exact (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hc).2 (by nlinarith)\n  have hzlo := le_trans hzl (hzmono hy.1)\n  have hzhi := le_trans (hzmono hy.2) hzu\n  refine ⟨⟨le_trans hi hy.1, le_trans hy.2 hU⟩, ⟨hzlo, hzhi⟩, ?_⟩\n  unfold netPower at *\n  constructor <;> nlinarith [hy.2]\n\n/- Comparing stages on any feasible subinterval, using the derived sign. -/\nlemma time_increasing_on_cooling :\n    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A u v : ℝ),\n    0 < C → 0 < C + S → 0 < k → u ≤ v →\n    (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, 0 < netPower W k A y ∧\n      0 < netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts y)) →\n    (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, 0 ≤ S * (y - Ts) + H) →\n    boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A u ≤ boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A v := by\n  intro C S H Ts B W k A u v hC hc hk huv hp hs\n  have hd := fun y hy => timing_derivative_signed C S H Ts B W k A y\n    (ne_of_gt hc) (ne_of_gt hk) (ne_of_gt (hp y hy).1) (ne_of_gt (hp y hy).2)\n  have hm : MonotoneOn (boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A) (Set.Icc u v) := by\n    apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Icc _ _)\n    · intro y hy\n      exact (hd y hy).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt\n    · intro y hy\n      exact (hd y (interior_subset hy)).hasDerivWithinAt\n    · intro y hy\n      have hm := interior_subset hy\n      exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hC)\n        (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hk) (hs y hm)) (le_of_lt hc)))\n        (le_of_lt (mul_pos (hp y hm).1 (hp y hm).2))\n  exact hm ⟨le_refl _, huv⟩ ⟨huv, le_refl _⟩ huv\n\nlemma time_decreasing_on_warming :\n    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A u v : ℝ),\n    0 < C → 0 < C + S → 0 < k → u ≤ v →\n    (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, 0 < netPower W k A y ∧\n      0 < netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts y)) →\n    (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, S * (y - Ts) + H ≤ 0) →\n    boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A v ≤ boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A u := by\n  intro C S H Ts B W k A u v hC hc hk huv hp hs\n  have hd := fun y hy => timing_derivative_signed C S H Ts B W k A y\n",

import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Deriv
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.MeanValue
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

/- Supplied starting temperature in degrees Celsius. -/
def initialTemperature : ℝ := 20

/- Constant heater input W, room temperature A, linear heat-loss
   coefficient k. This SAME law applies to water and brine (watts). -/
def netPower (W k A T : ℝ) : ℝ := W - k * (T - A)

/- Instantaneous conservation of energy on adding salt: C is water+pot
   capacity, S = final solution capacity minus original water capacity (signed),
   Ts salt temperature and enthalpy reference, H dissolution energy at Ts. Capacities J/K, H joules. -/
noncomputable def mixedTemperature (C S H Ts x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (C * x + S * Ts - H) / (C + S)

/- Integrated inverse energy balance dt/dT = capacity/netPower(T).
   Used only where net power is positive and k>0. -/
noncomputable def heatingTime (capacity W k A u v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  capacity / k * (Real.log (netPower W k A u) - Real.log (netPower W k A v))

/- Total seconds to a fixed final solution boiling temperature B when
   salt is added at unsalted temperature x. The mixing temperature jump and the
   changed heat capacity are both included. -/
noncomputable def boilingTime (C S H Ts B W k A x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  heatingTime C W k A initialTemperature x +
  heatingTime (C + S) W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) B

/- H is the isothermal dissolution energy at Ts, not at every x.
   If cs is solid salt capacity, Kirchhoff gives dissolution energy
   H+(S-cs)*(x-Ts) at x. Warming the solid to x costs cs*(x-Ts).
   Thus their sum is H+S*(x-Ts), for either sign of S. -/
lemma reference_consistent_balance :
    ∀ (C S H Ts cs x z : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 →
    ((C + S) * (z - x) + cs * (x - Ts) +
      (H + (S - cs) * (x - Ts)) = 0 ↔
      z = mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) := by
  intro C S H Ts cs x z hc
  unfold mixedTemperature
  rw [eq_div_iff hc]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith

/- Derived conservation of enthalpy; no presumed mixing-temperature sign. -/
lemma mixing_balance :
    ∀ (C S H Ts x : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 →
    (C + S) * mixedTemperature C S H Ts x = C * x + S * Ts - H := by
  intro C S H Ts x hc
  unfold mixedTemperature
  field_simp

/- Derive the net-power jump from energy conservation AND the shared
   heat-transfer law; before/after powers are not independent parameters. -/
lemma power_change :
    ∀ (C S H Ts W k A x : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 →
    netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) - netPower W k A x =
      k * (S * (x - Ts) + H) / (C + S) := by
  intro C S H Ts W k A x hc
  unfold netPower mixedTemperature
  field_simp
  ring

lemma power_derivative :
    ∀ (W k A x : ℝ), HasDerivAt (netPower W k A) (-k) x := by
  intro W k A x
  unfold netPower
  convert (((hasDerivAt_id x).sub_const A).const_mul k).const_sub W using 1 <;> simp

/- Checks the integrated heating law against the differential first law:
   increasing endpoint temperature costs capacity/netPower seconds/K. -/
lemma heating_time_derivative :
    ∀ (capacity W k A u v : ℝ), k ≠ 0 → netPower W k A v ≠ 0 →
    HasDerivAt (fun y => heatingTime capacity W k A u y)
      (capacity / netPower W k A v) v := by
  intro capacity W k A u v hk hv
  have h := (((power_derivative W k A v).log hv).const_sub
    (Real.log (netPower W k A u))).const_mul (capacity / k)
  unfold heatingTime
  convert h using 1
  field_simp [hk, hv]

/- Derivation of the stage-time formula from the inverse first law.
   For any elapsed-time curve f with df/dT = capacity/netPower and f(u)=0,
   the endpoint time MUST equal heatingTime; it is not a fitted formula.
   Endpoint derivatives may be read as those of a smooth local extension. -/
lemma stage_time_from_energy :
    ∀ (capacity W k A u v : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ),
    u ≤ v → k ≠ 0 →
    (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, 0 < netPower W k A y) →
    (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, HasDerivAt f (capacity / netPower W k A y) y) →
    f u = 0 → f v = heatingTime capacity W k A u v := by
  intro capacity W k A u v f huv hk hp hf hu
  have mono : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, HasDerivAt g 0 y) → MonotoneOn g (Set.Icc u v) := by
    intro g hg
    apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Icc _ _)
    · intro y hy
      exact (hg y hy).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · intro y hy
      exact (hg y (interior_subset hy)).hasDerivWithinAt
    · intro y hy
      exact le_refl 0
  have hd : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v,
      HasDerivAt (fun w => f w - heatingTime capacity W k A u w) 0 y := by
    intro y hy
    have hh := heating_time_derivative capacity W k A u y hk (ne_of_gt (hp y hy))
    convert (hf y hy).sub hh using 1 <;> simp
  have hm := mono (fun w => f w - heatingTime capacity W k A u w) hd
  have hn := mono (fun w => -(f w - heatingTime capacity W k A u w)) (by
    intro y hy
    convert (hd y hy).neg using 1 <;> simp)
  have hle := hm ⟨le_refl u, huv⟩ ⟨huv, le_refl v⟩ huv
  have hge := hn ⟨le_refl u, huv⟩ ⟨huv, le_refl v⟩ huv
  have hzero : heatingTime capacity W k A u u = 0 := by
    simp only [heatingTime, sub_self, mul_zero]
  linarith

/- Eliminate the two heating stages. The derivative compares the time
   spent heating unsalted water with the time saved in the salted stage. -/
lemma boiling_time_derivative :
    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A x : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 → k ≠ 0 →
    netPower W k A x ≠ 0 →
    netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) ≠ 0 →
    HasDerivAt (boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A)
      (C / netPower W k A x -
       C / netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x)) x := by
  intro C S H Ts B W k A x hc hk hx hz
  have hm : HasDerivAt (mixedTemperature C S H Ts) (C / (C + S)) x := by
    unfold mixedTemperature
    convert ((((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul C).add_const (S * Ts)).sub_const H).div_const
      (C + S) using 1 <;> simp
  have hn := (power_derivative W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x)).comp x hm
  have hpost := (((hn.log hz).sub_const
    (Real.log (netPower W k A B))).const_mul ((C + S) / k))
  have hpre := heating_time_derivative C W k A initialTemperature x hk hx
  convert hpre.add hpost using 1
  · rfl
  · dsimp only [Function.comp_apply]
    field_simp [hc, hk, hx, hz]
    ring

/- The derivative has precisely the sign of the net cooling energy
   D(x)=S*(x-Ts)+H when capacities and net powers are positive. -/
lemma timing_derivative_signed :
    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A x : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 → k ≠ 0 →
    netPower W k A x ≠ 0 →
    netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) ≠ 0 →
    HasDerivAt (boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A)
      (C * (k * (S * (x - Ts) + H) / (C + S)) /
        (netPower W k A x * netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x))) x := by
  intro C S H Ts B W k A x hc hk hx hz
  have hj := power_change C S H Ts W k A x hc
  have he : C / netPower W k A x - C / netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) =
      C * (k * (S * (x - Ts) + H) / (C + S)) /
        (netPower W k A x * netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x)) := by
    rw [← hj]
    field_simp
    <;> ring
  rw [← he]
  exact boiling_time_derivative C S H Ts B W k A x hc hk hx hz

/- Constant-capacity mixing is increasing in the addition temperature,
   even if S<0. Endpoint constraints keep the entire trajectory liquid.
   F is a common liquid lower bound; B0 is unsalted boiling temperature. -/
lemma feasible_trajectory :
    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A F B0 L U y : ℝ),
    0 < C → 0 < C + S → 0 < k →
    F ≤ initialTemperature → initialTemperature ≤ L → L ≤ U → U ≤ B0 →
    F ≤ mixedTemperature C S H Ts L → mixedTemperature C S H Ts U ≤ B →
    0 < netPower W k A U → 0 < netPower W k A B →
    y ∈ Set.Icc L U →
    (initialTemperature ≤ y ∧ y ≤ B0) ∧
    (F ≤ mixedTemperature C S H Ts y ∧ mixedTemperature C S H Ts y ≤ B) ∧
    (0 < netPower W k A y ∧ 0 < netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts y)) := by
  intro C S H Ts B W k A F B0 L U y hC hc hk hF hi hLU hU hzl hzu hpU hpB hy
  have hzmono : Monotone (mixedTemperature C S H Ts) := by
    intro a b hab
    unfold mixedTemperature
    exact (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hc).2 (by nlinarith)
  have hzlo := le_trans hzl (hzmono hy.1)
  have hzhi := le_trans (hzmono hy.2) hzu
  refine ⟨⟨le_trans hi hy.1, le_trans hy.2 hU⟩, ⟨hzlo, hzhi⟩, ?_⟩
  unfold netPower at *
  constructor <;> nlinarith [hy.2]

/- Comparing stages on any feasible subinterval, using the derived sign. -/
lemma time_increasing_on_cooling :
    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A u v : ℝ),
    0 < C → 0 < C + S → 0 < k → u ≤ v →
    (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, 0 < netPower W k A y ∧
      0 < netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts y)) →
    (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, 0 ≤ S * (y - Ts) + H) →
    boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A u ≤ boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A v := by
  intro C S H Ts B W k A u v hC hc hk huv hp hs
  have hd := fun y hy => timing_derivative_signed C S H Ts B W k A y
    (ne_of_gt hc) (ne_of_gt hk) (ne_of_gt (hp y hy).1) (ne_of_gt (hp y hy).2)
  have hm : MonotoneOn (boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A) (Set.Icc u v) := by
    apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Icc _ _)
    · intro y hy
      exact (hd y hy).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · intro y hy
      exact (hd y (interior_subset hy)).hasDerivWithinAt
    · intro y hy
      have hm := interior_subset hy
      exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hC)
        (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hk) (hs y hm)) (le_of_lt hc)))
        (le_of_lt (mul_pos (hp y hm).1 (hp y hm).2))
  exact hm ⟨le_refl _, huv⟩ ⟨huv, le_refl _⟩ huv

lemma time_decreasing_on_warming :
    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A u v : ℝ),
    0 < C → 0 < C + S → 0 < k → u ≤ v →
    (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, 0 < netPower W k A y ∧
      0 < netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts y)) →
    (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, S * (y - Ts) + H ≤ 0) →
    boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A v ≤ boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A u := by
  intro C S H Ts B W k A u v hC hc hk huv hp hs
  have hd := fun y hy => timing_derivative_signed C S H Ts B W k A y
    (ne_of_gt hc) (ne_of_gt hk) (ne_of_gt (hp y hy).1) (ne_of_gt (hp y hy).2)
  have hm : MonotoneOn (fun y => -boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A y) (Set.Icc u v) := by
    apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Icc _ _)
    · intro y hy
      exact (hd y hy).neg.continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · intro y hy
      exact (hd y (interior_subset hy)).neg.hasDerivWithinAt
    · intro y hy
      have hm := interior_subset hy
      have hn : C * (k * (S * (y - Ts) + H) / (C + S)) /
          (netPower W k A y * netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts y)) ≤ 0 :=
        div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
          (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hC)
            (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
              (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hk) (hs y hm)) (le_of_lt hc)))
          (le_of_lt (mul_pos (hp y hm).1 (hp y hm).2))
      exact neg_nonneg.mpr hn
  have hh := hm ⟨le_refl _, huv⟩ ⟨huv, le_refl _⟩ huv
  linarith

/- Conditional scientific answer over an explicitly feasible interval.
   S>=0: earliest, latest, or interior root as D changes sign.
   S<=0: compare endpoint boiling times. S=H=0: all schedules tie.
   H is allowed either sign; mixing need not cool or increase net power. -/
theorem addition_timing_answer :
    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A F B0 L U x : ℝ),
    0 < C → 0 < C + S → 0 < k →
    F ≤ initialTemperature → initialTemperature ≤ L → L ≤ U → U ≤ B0 →
    F ≤ mixedTemperature C S H Ts L → mixedTemperature C S H Ts U ≤ B →
    0 < netPower W k A U → 0 < netPower W k A B →
    x ∈ Set.Icc L U →
    (netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) - netPower W k A x =
      k * (S * (x - Ts) + H) / (C + S)) ∧
    (0 ≤ S → 0 ≤ S * (L - Ts) + H →
      boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A L ≤ boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A x) ∧
    (0 ≤ S → S * (U - Ts) + H ≤ 0 →
      boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A U ≤ boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A x) ∧
    (0 < S → Ts - H / S ∈ Set.Icc L U →
      boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A (Ts - H / S) ≤ boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A x) ∧
    (S ≤ 0 →
      min (boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A L) (boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A U) ≤
        boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A x) ∧
    (S = 0 → H = 0 →
      boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A L = boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A x) := by
  intro C S H Ts B W k A F B0 L U x hC hc hk hF hi hLU hU hzl hzu hpU hpB hx
  have hp : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc L U, 0 < netPower W k A y ∧
      0 < netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts y) := by
    intro y hy
    exact (feasible_trajectory C S H Ts B W k A F B0 L U y
      hC hc hk hF hi hLU hU hzl hzu hpU hpB hy).2.2
  have inc : ∀ u v, L ≤ u → v ≤ U → u ≤ v →
      (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, 0 ≤ S * (y - Ts) + H) →
      boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A u ≤ boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A v := by
    intro u v hlu hvu huv hs
    apply time_increasing_on_cooling C S H Ts B W k A u v hC hc hk huv
    · intro y hy
      exact hp y ⟨le_trans hlu hy.1, le_trans hy.2 hvu⟩
    · exact hs
  have dec : ∀ u v, L ≤ u → v ≤ U → u ≤ v →
      (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, S * (y - Ts) + H ≤ 0) →
      boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A v ≤ boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A u := by
    intro u v hlu hvu huv hs
    apply time_decreasing_on_warming C S H Ts B W k A u v hC hc hk huv
    · intro y hy
      exact hp y ⟨le_trans hlu hy.1, le_trans hy.2 hvu⟩
    · exact hs
  refine ⟨power_change C S H Ts W k A x (ne_of_gt hc), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hS hD
    apply inc L x (le_refl _) hx.2 hx.1
    intro y hy
    nlinarith [hy.1]
  · intro hS hD
    apply dec x U hx.1 (le_refl _) hx.2
    intro y hy
    nlinarith [hy.2]
  · intro hS hr
    have hroot : S * ((Ts - H / S) - Ts) + H = 0 := by
      field_simp
      <;> ring
    by_cases hxr : x ≤ Ts - H / S
    · apply dec x (Ts - H / S) hx.1 hr.2 hxr
      intro y hy
      nlinarith [hy.2]
    · apply inc (Ts - H / S) x hr.1 hx.2 (le_of_not_ge hxr)
      intro y hy
      nlinarith [hy.1]
  · intro hS
    by_cases hD : 0 ≤ S * (x - Ts) + H
    · apply le_trans (min_le_left _ _)
      apply inc L x (le_refl _) hx.2 hx.1
      intro y hy
      nlinarith [hy.2]
    · apply le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
      apply dec x U hx.1 (le_refl _) hx.2
      intro y hy
      have hh := le_of_not_ge hD
      nlinarith [hy.1]
  · intro hS hH
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply inc L x (le_refl _) hx.2 hx.1
      intro y hy
      simp [hS, hH]
    · apply dec L x (le_refl _) hx.2 hx.1
      intro y hy
      simp [hS, hH]

/- Concrete scenario: 10 g crystalline NaCl at 20 C. Molar mass 58.443
   g/mol (NIST); solvent mass .99820675 kg from 1 L and NIST density.
   PI(con) v and q are linearly interpolated between the published .15
   and .20 mol/kg entries. This is an empirical interpolation, not new data.
   Result: relative apparent molar enthalpy, J/mol, Kelvin used in T². -/
noncomputable def naclRelativeEnthalpy (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let m : ℝ := 10 / (58.443 * 0.99820675)
  let f := (m - 0.15) / 0.05
  let v := (-0.8329 + f * 0.7802) / 1000
  let q := (-60.2 - f * 13.3) / 1000000;
  -(t + 273.15)^2 * (v + 2 * q * t)

/- Integral dissolution energy, joules, at the actual salt/reference
   temperature 20 C. Interpolate Criss-Cobble's 19.97 and 25 C standard
   solid-dissolution data, THEN add the same-temperature relative term. -/
noncomputable def naclDissolutionAt20 : ℝ :=
  (10 / 58.443) *
    (4481 - (20 - 19.97) * 657 / (25 - 19.97) + naclRelativeEnthalpy 20)

/- Effective constant solution-minus-water capacity, J/K, inferred as
   the 20-to-100 C SECANT of the apparent enthalpy with solid salt fixed
   at 20 C. It is NOT the local heat capacity at 25 C.
   Extend the last measured standard-dissolution segment (84.98,95.18 C)
   linearly to 100 C; add solid sensible heat 51 J/(mol K) * 80 K and
   the finite-concentration correction. These extensions/approximations
   are explicit empirical scenario choices, not certified error bounds. -/
noncomputable def naclCapacityChange : ℝ :=
  ((10 / 58.443) *
    (-4540 - (100 - 95.18) * 1318 / (95.18 - 84.98) +
      51 * (100 - 20) + naclRelativeEnthalpy 100) - naclDissolutionAt20) / 80

/- Derived material signs/bounds. No assumed sign for total capacity
   change; these follow from the stated data and interpolation model. -/
lemma nacl_material_inference :
    810 ≤ naclDissolutionAt20 ∧ naclDissolutionAt20 ≤ 820 ∧
    -9 ≤ naclCapacityChange ∧ naclCapacityChange ≤ -8 := by
  norm_num [naclDissolutionAt20, naclCapacityChange, naclRelativeEnthalpy]

   heater can reach B despite losses. Any addition temperature x from
   the initial 20 C through onset of UNSALTED boiling is allowed.

   increased net power after mixing, and immediate addition minimizes

    B0 ≤ B → B ≤ ((101 : ℕ) : ℝ) → k * (B - initialTemperature) < W →
    x ∈ Set.Icc initialTemperature B0 →

    (((19 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ mixedTemperature C naclCapacityChange naclDissolutionAt20 initialTemperature x ∧
      mixedTemperature C naclCapacityChange naclDissolutionAt20 initialTemperature x ≤ x) ∧
    (0 < netPower W k initialTemperature x ∧
      netPower W k initialTemperature x <
        netPower W k initialTemperature (mixedTemperature C naclCapacityChange naclDissolutionAt20 initialTemperature x)) ∧
    boilingTime C naclCapacityChange naclDissolutionAt20 initialTemperature B W k initialTemperature initialTemperature ≤
      boilingTime C naclCapacityChange naclDissolutionAt20 initialTemperature B W k initialTemperature x := by
  intro C W k B0 B x hC hk hBlo hBhi hB hBmax hW hx
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat] at hC hBlo hBhi hBmax ⊢

    initialTemperature x hc0 hc hk hx.1
  · intro y hy
    exact (feasible_trajectory C naclCapacityChange naclDissolutionAt20 20 B W k 20
      19 B0 initialTemperature B0 y hc0 hc hk (by rw [hi]; norm_num)
      (le_refl _) hdomain (le_refl _) hz19 hzB hpow0 hpowB

import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Deriv
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.MeanValue
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

/- Supplied starting temperature in degrees Celsius. -/
def initialTemperature : ℝ := 20

/- Constant heater input W, room temperature A, linear heat-loss
   coefficient k. This SAME law applies to water and brine (watts). -/
def netPower (W k A T : ℝ) : ℝ := W - k * (T - A)

/- Instantaneous conservation of energy on adding salt: C is water+pot
   capacity, S the additional capacity, Ts salt temperature, H dissolution
   energy absorbed. Capacities J/K, H joules. -/
noncomputable def mixedTemperature (C S H Ts x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (C * x + S * Ts - H) / (C + S)

/- Integrated inverse energy balance dt/dT = capacity/netPower(T).
   Used only where net power is positive and k>0. -/
noncomputable def heatingTime (capacity W k A u v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  capacity / k * (Real.log (netPower W k A u) - Real.log (netPower W k A v))

/- Total seconds to a fixed final solution boiling temperature B when
   salt is added at unsalted temperature x. The initial cooling and the
   changed heat capacity are both included. -/
noncomputable def boilingTime (C S H Ts B W k A x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  heatingTime C W k A initialTemperature x +
  heatingTime (C + S) W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) B

/- Derive the mixing balance rather than assuming a cooling amount. -/
lemma mixing_balance :
    ∀ (C S H Ts x : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 →
    (C + S) * mixedTemperature C S H Ts x = C * x + S * Ts - H := by
  intro C S H Ts x hc
  unfold mixedTemperature
  field_simp

/- Derive the net-power jump from energy conservation AND the shared
   heat-transfer law; before/after powers are not independent parameters. -/
lemma power_change :
    ∀ (C S H Ts W k A x : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 →
    netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) - netPower W k A x =
      k * (S * (x - Ts) + H) / (C + S) := by
  intro C S H Ts W k A x hc
  unfold netPower mixedTemperature
  field_simp
  ring

lemma power_derivative :
    ∀ (W k A x : ℝ), HasDerivAt (netPower W k A) (-k) x := by
  intro W k A x
  unfold netPower
  convert (((hasDerivAt_id x).sub_const A).const_mul k).const_sub W using 1 <;> simp

/- Checks the integrated heating law against the differential first law:
   increasing endpoint temperature costs capacity/netPower seconds/K. -/
lemma heating_time_derivative :
    ∀ (capacity W k A u v : ℝ), k ≠ 0 → netPower W k A v ≠ 0 →
    HasDerivAt (fun y => heatingTime capacity W k A u y)
      (capacity / netPower W k A v) v := by
  intro capacity W k A u v hk hv
  have h := (((power_derivative W k A v).log hv).const_sub
    (Real.log (netPower W k A u))).const_mul (capacity / k)
  unfold heatingTime
  convert h using 1
  field_simp [hk, hv]

/- Derivation of the stage-time formula from the inverse first law.
   For any elapsed-time curve f with df/dT = capacity/netPower and f(u)=0,
   the endpoint time MUST equal heatingTime; it is not a fitted formula.
   Endpoint derivatives may be read as those of a smooth local extension. -/
lemma stage_time_from_energy :
    ∀ (capacity W k A u v : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ),
    u ≤ v → k ≠ 0 →
    (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, 0 < netPower W k A y) →
    (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, HasDerivAt f (capacity / netPower W k A y) y) →
    f u = 0 → f v = heatingTime capacity W k A u v := by
  intro capacity W k A u v f huv hk hp hf hu
  have mono : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, HasDerivAt g 0 y) → MonotoneOn g (Set.Icc u v) := by
    intro g hg
    apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Icc _ _)
    · intro y hy
      exact (hg y hy).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · intro y hy
      exact (hg y (interior_subset hy)).hasDerivWithinAt
    · intro y hy
      exact le_refl 0
  have hd : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v,
      HasDerivAt (fun w => f w - heatingTime capacity W k A u w) 0 y := by
    intro y hy
    have hh := heating_time_derivative capacity W k A u y hk (ne_of_gt (hp y hy))
    convert (hf y hy).sub hh using 1 <;> simp
  have hm := mono (fun w => f w - heatingTime capacity W k A u w) hd
  have hn := mono (fun w => -(f w - heatingTime capacity W k A u w)) (by
    intro y hy
    convert (hd y hy).neg using 1 <;> simp)
  have hle := hm ⟨le_refl u, huv⟩ ⟨huv, le_refl v⟩ huv
  have hge := hn ⟨le_refl u, huv⟩ ⟨huv, le_refl v⟩ huv
  have hzero : heatingTime capacity W k A u u = 0 := by
    simp only [heatingTime, sub_self, mul_zero]
  linarith

/- Eliminate the two heating stages. The derivative compares the time
   spent heating unsalted water with the time saved in the salted stage. -/
lemma boiling_time_derivative :
    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A x : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 → k ≠ 0 →
    netPower W k A x ≠ 0 →
    netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) ≠ 0 →
    HasDerivAt (boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A)
      (C / netPower W k A x -
       C / netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x)) x := by
  intro C S H Ts B W k A x hc hk hx hz
  have hm : HasDerivAt (mixedTemperature C S H Ts) (C / (C + S)) x := by
    unfold mixedTemperature
    convert ((((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul C).add_const (S * Ts)).sub_const H).div_const
      (C + S) using 1 <;> simp
  have hn := (power_derivative W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x)).comp x hm
  have hpost := (((hn.log hz).sub_const
    (Real.log (netPower W k A B))).const_mul ((C + S) / k))
  have hpre := heating_time_derivative C W k A initialTemperature x hk hx
  convert hpre.add hpost using 1
  · rfl
  · dsimp only [Function.comp_apply]
    field_simp [hc, hk, hx, hz]
    ring

/- Positive net power up to B, cool salt, and nonnegative dissolution cost
   imply cooling on mixing, hence an increase of net power at that instant.
   The heat-transfer coefficient itself has NOT been increased by salt. -/
lemma power_order :
    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A x : ℝ),
    0 < C → 0 ≤ S → 0 ≤ H → Ts ≤ initialTemperature →
    0 < k → 0 < netPower W k A B →
    initialTemperature ≤ x → x ≤ B →
    0 < netPower W k A x ∧
    netPower W k A x ≤ netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) := by
  intro C S H Ts B W k A x hC hS hH hTs hk hB hix hxB
  have hc : 0 < C + S := by linarith
  have hcool : 0 ≤ S * (x - Ts) + H :=
    add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hS (by linarith)) hH
  have hjump := power_change C S H Ts W k A x (ne_of_gt hc)
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ k * (S * (x - Ts) + H) / (C + S) :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hk) hcool) (le_of_lt hc)
  have hp : 0 < netPower W k A x := by
    unfold netPower at *
    nlinarith
  exact ⟨hp, by linarith⟩

/- Scientific answer: in this explicit Newton-loss model immediate
   addition (20 C, elapsed time zero) is a global weak minimum over
   admissible later additions. Also expose the derived power jump. -/
theorem addition_timing_answer :
    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A x : ℝ),
    0 < C → 0 ≤ S → 0 ≤ H → Ts ≤ initialTemperature →
    0 < k → 0 < netPower W k A B →
    initialTemperature ≤ x → x ≤ B →
    (netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) - netPower W k A x =
      k * (S * (x - Ts) + H) / (C + S)) ∧
    (netPower W k A x ≤ netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x)) ∧
    (boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A initialTemperature ≤
      boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A x) ∧
    (heatingTime C W k A initialTemperature initialTemperature = 0) := by
  intro C S H Ts B W k A x hC hS hH hTs hk hB hix hxB
  have hc : 0 < C + S := by linarith
  have hord := power_order C S H Ts B W k A x hC hS hH hTs hk hB hix hxB
  refine ⟨power_change C S H Ts W k A x (ne_of_gt hc), hord.2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hd : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc initialTemperature B,
        HasDerivAt (boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A)
          (C / netPower W k A y -
           C / netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts y)) y := by
      intro y hy
      have ho := power_order C S H Ts B W k A y hC hS hH hTs hk hB hy.1 hy.2
      exact boiling_time_derivative C S H Ts B W k A y (ne_of_gt hc)
        (ne_of_gt hk) (ne_of_gt ho.1) (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le ho.1 ho.2))
    have hm : MonotoneOn (boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A)
        (Set.Icc initialTemperature B) := by
      apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Icc _ _)
      · intro y hy
        exact (hd y hy).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      · intro y hy
        exact (hd y (interior_subset hy)).hasDerivWithinAt
      · intro y hy
        have hmem := interior_subset hy
        have ho := power_order C S H Ts B W k A y hC hS hH hTs hk hB hmem.1 hmem.2
        have hz : 0 < netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts y) :=
          lt_of_lt_of_le ho.1 ho.2
        have he : C / netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts y) ≤
            C / netPower W k A y := by
          apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hz ho.1).2
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ho.2 (le_of_lt hC)
        linarith
    exact hm ⟨le_refl _, le_trans hix hxB⟩ ⟨hix, hxB⟩ hix
  · unfold heatingTime
    rw [sub_self, mul_zero]

import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Deriv
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.MeanValue
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

/- Supplied starting temperature in degrees Celsius. -/
def initialTemperature : ℝ := 20

/- Constant heater input W, room temperature A, linear heat-loss
   coefficient k. This SAME law applies to water and brine (watts). -/
def netPower (W k A T : ℝ) : ℝ := W - k * (T - A)

/- Instantaneous conservation of energy on adding salt: C is water+pot
   capacity, S = final solution capacity minus original water capacity (signed),
   Ts salt temperature and enthalpy reference, H dissolution energy at Ts. Capacities J/K, H joules. -/
noncomputable def mixedTemperature (C S H Ts x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (C * x + S * Ts - H) / (C + S)

/- Integrated inverse energy balance dt/dT = capacity/netPower(T).
   Used only where net power is positive and k>0. -/
noncomputable def heatingTime (capacity W k A u v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  capacity / k * (Real.log (netPower W k A u) - Real.log (netPower W k A v))

/- Total seconds to a fixed final solution boiling temperature B when
   salt is added at unsalted temperature x. The mixing temperature jump and the
   changed heat capacity are both included. -/
noncomputable def boilingTime (C S H Ts B W k A x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  heatingTime C W k A initialTemperature x +
  heatingTime (C + S) W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) B

/- H is the isothermal dissolution energy at Ts, not at every x.
   If cs is solid salt capacity, Kirchhoff gives dissolution energy
   H+(S-cs)*(x-Ts) at x. Warming the solid to x costs cs*(x-Ts).
   Thus their sum is H+S*(x-Ts), for either sign of S. -/
lemma reference_consistent_balance :
    ∀ (C S H Ts cs x z : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 →
    ((C + S) * (z - x) + cs * (x - Ts) +
      (H + (S - cs) * (x - Ts)) = 0 ↔
      z = mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) := by
  intro C S H Ts cs x z hc
  unfold mixedTemperature
  rw [eq_div_iff hc]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith

/- Derived conservation of enthalpy; no presumed mixing-temperature sign. -/
lemma mixing_balance :
    ∀ (C S H Ts x : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 →
    (C + S) * mixedTemperature C S H Ts x = C * x + S * Ts - H := by
  intro C S H Ts x hc
  unfold mixedTemperature
  field_simp

      k * (S * (x - Ts) + H) / (C + S) := by
  intro C S H Ts W k A x hc
  unfold netPower mixedTemperature
  field_simp
  ring

    ∀ (W k A x : ℝ), HasDerivAt (netPower W k A) (-k) x := by
  intro W k A x

/- Eliminate the two heating stages. The derivative compares the time

lemma boiling_time_derivative :

/- The derivative has precisely the sign of the net cooling energy
   D(x)=S*(x-Ts)+H when capacities and net powers are positive. -/
lemma timing_derivative_signed :
    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A x : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 → k ≠ 0 →
    netPower W k A x ≠ 0 →
    netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) ≠ 0 →
    HasDerivAt (boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A)
      (C * (k * (S * (x - Ts) + H) / (C + S)) /
        (netPower W k A x * netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x))) x := by
  intro C S H Ts B W k A x hc hk hx hz
  have hj := power_change C S H Ts W k A x hc
  have he : C / netPower W k A x - C / netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) =
      C * (k * (S * (x - Ts) + H) / (C + S)) /
        (netPower W k A x * netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x)) := by
    rw [← hj]
    field_simp
    <;> ring
  rw [← he]
  exact boiling_time_derivative C S H Ts B W k A x hc hk hx hz

/- Constant-capacity mixing is increasing in the addition temperature,
   even if S<0. Endpoint constraints keep the entire trajectory liquid.
   F is a common liquid lower bound; B0 is unsalted boiling temperature. -/
lemma feasible_trajectory :
    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A F B0 L U y : ℝ),
    0 < C → 0 < C + S → 0 < k →
    F ≤ initialTemperature → initialTemperature ≤ L → L ≤ U → U ≤ B0 →
    F ≤ mixedTemperature C S H Ts L → mixedTemperature C S H Ts U ≤ B →
    0 < netPower W k A U → 0 < netPower W k A B →
    y ∈ Set.Icc L U →
    (initialTemperature ≤ y ∧ y ≤ B0) ∧
    (F ≤ mixedTemperature C S H Ts y ∧ mixedTemperature C S H Ts y ≤ B) ∧
    (0 < netPower W k A y ∧ 0 < netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts y)) := by
  intro C S H Ts B W k A F B0 L U y hC hc hk hF hi hLU hU hzl hzu hpU hpB hy
  have hzmono : Monotone (mixedTemperature C S H Ts) := by
    intro a b hab
    unfold mixedTemperature
    exact (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hc).2 (by nlinarith)
  have hzlo := le_trans hzl (hzmono hy.1)
  have hzhi := le_trans (hzmono hy.2) hzu
  refine ⟨⟨le_trans hi hy.1, le_trans hy.2 hU⟩, ⟨hzlo, hzhi⟩, ?_⟩
  unfold netPower at *
  constructor <;> nlinarith [hy.2]

/- Comparing stages on any feasible subinterval, using the derived sign. -/
lemma time_increasing_on_cooling :
    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A u v : ℝ),
    0 < C → 0 < C + S → 0 < k → u ≤ v →
    (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, 0 < netPower W k A y ∧
      0 < netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts y)) →
    (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, 0 ≤ S * (y - Ts) + H) →
    boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A u ≤ boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A v := by
  intro C S H Ts B W k A u v hC hc hk huv hp hs
  have hd := fun y hy => timing_derivative_signed C S H Ts B W k A y
    (ne_of_gt hc) (ne_of_gt hk) (ne_of_gt (hp y hy).1) (ne_of_gt (hp y hy).2)
  have hm : MonotoneOn (boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A) (Set.Icc u v) := by
    apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Icc _ _)
    · intro y hy
      exact (hd y hy).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · intro y hy
      exact (hd y (interior_subset hy)).hasDerivWithinAt
    · intro y hy
      have hm := interior_subset hy
      exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hC)
        (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hk) (hs y hm)) (le_of_lt hc)))
        (le_of_lt (mul_pos (hp y hm).1 (hp y hm).2))
  exact hm ⟨le_refl _, huv⟩ ⟨huv, le_refl _⟩ huv

lemma time_decreasing_on_warming :
    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A u v : ℝ),
    0 < C → 0 < C + S → 0 < k → u ≤ v →
    (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, 0 < netPower W k A y ∧
      0 < netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts y)) →
    (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, S * (y - Ts) + H ≤ 0) →
    boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A v ≤ boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A u := by
  intro C S H Ts B W k A u v hC hc hk huv hp hs
  have hd := fun y hy => timing_derivative_signed C S H Ts B W k A y
    (ne_of_gt hc) (ne_of_gt hk) (ne_of_gt (hp y hy).1) (ne_of_gt (hp y hy).2)
  have hm : MonotoneOn (fun y => -boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A y) (Set.Icc u v) := by
    apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Icc _ _)
    · intro y hy
      exact (hd y hy).neg.continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · intro y hy
      exact (hd y (interior_subset hy)).neg.hasDerivWithinAt
    · intro y hy
      have hm := interior_subset hy
      have hn : C * (k * (S * (y - Ts) + H) / (C + S)) /
          (netPower W k A y * netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts y)) ≤ 0 :=
        div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
          (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hC)
            (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
              (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hk) (hs y hm)) (le_of_lt hc)))
          (le_of_lt (mul_pos (hp y hm).1 (hp y hm).2))
      exact neg_nonneg.mpr hn
  have hh := hm ⟨le_refl _, huv⟩ ⟨huv, le_refl _⟩ huv
  linarith

/- Conditional scientific answer over an explicitly feasible interval.
   S>=0: earliest, latest, or interior root as D changes sign.
   S<=0: compare endpoint boiling times. S=H=0: all schedules tie.
   H is allowed either sign; mixing need not cool or increase net power. -/
theorem addition_timing_answer :
    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A F B0 L U x : ℝ),
    0 < C → 0 < C + S → 0 < k →
    F ≤ initialTemperature → initialTemperature ≤ L → L ≤ U → U ≤ B0 →
    F ≤ mixedTemperature C S H Ts L → mixedTemperature C S H Ts U ≤ B →
    0 < netPower W k A U → 0 < netPower W k A B →
    x ∈ Set.Icc L U →
    (netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) - netPower W k A x =
      k * (S * (x - Ts) + H) / (C + S)) ∧
    (0 ≤ S → 0 ≤ S * (L - Ts) + H →
      boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A L ≤ boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A x) ∧
    (0 ≤ S → S * (U - Ts) + H ≤ 0 →
      boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A U ≤ boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A x) ∧
    (0 < S → Ts - H / S ∈ Set.Icc L U →
      boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A (Ts - H / S) ≤ boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A x) ∧
    (S ≤ 0 →
      min (boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A L) (boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A U) ≤
        boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A x) ∧
    (S = 0 → H = 0 →
      boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A L = boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A x) := by
  intro C S H Ts B W k A F B0 L U x hC hc hk hF hi hLU hU hzl hzu hpU hpB hx
  have hp : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc L U, 0 < netPower W k A y ∧
      0 < netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts y) := by
    intro y hy
    exact (feasible_trajectory C S H Ts B W k A F B0 L U y
      hC hc hk hF hi hLU hU hzl hzu hpU hpB hy).2.2
  have inc : ∀ u v, L ≤ u → v ≤ U → u ≤ v →
      (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, 0 ≤ S * (y - Ts) + H) →
      boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A u ≤ boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A v := by

/- Concrete scenario: 10 g crystalline NaCl at 20 C. Molar mass 58.443
   g/mol (NIST); solvent mass .99820675 kg from 1 L and NIST density.
   PI(con) v and q are linearly interpolated between the published .15
   and .20 mol/kg entries. This is an empirical interpolation, not new data.
   Result: relative apparent molar enthalpy, J/mol, Kelvin used in T². -/
noncomputable def naclRelativeEnthalpy (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let m : ℝ := 10 / (58.443 * 0.99820675)
  let f := (m - 0.15) / 0.05
  let v := (-0.8329 + f * 0.7802) / 1000
  let q := (-60.2 - f * 13.3) / 1000000;
  -(t + 273.15)^2 * (v + 2 * q * t)

/- Integral dissolution energy, joules, at the actual salt/reference
   temperature 20 C. Interpolate Criss-Cobble's 19.97 and 25 C standard
   solid-dissolution data, THEN add the same-temperature relative term. -/
noncomputable def naclDissolutionAt20 : ℝ :=
  (10 / 58.443) *
    (4481 - (20 - 19.97) * 657 / (25 - 19.97) + naclRelativeEnthalpy 20)

/- Effective constant solution-minus-water capacity, J/K, inferred as
   the 20-to-100 C SECANT of the apparent enthalpy with solid salt fixed
   at 20 C. It is NOT the local heat capacity at 25 C.
   Extend the last measured standard-dissolution segment (84.98,95.18 C)
   linearly to 100 C; add solid sensible heat 51 J/(mol K) * 80 K and
   the finite-concentration correction. These extensions/approximations
   are explicit empirical scenario choices, not certified error bounds. -/
noncomputable def naclCapacityChange : ℝ :=
  ((10 / 58.443) *
    (-4540 - (100 - 95.18) * 1318 / (95.18 - 84.98) +
      51 * (100 - 20) + naclRelativeEnthalpy 100) - naclDissolutionAt20) / 80

/- Derived material signs/bounds. No assumed sign for total capacity
   change; these follow from the stated data and interpolation model. -/
lemma nacl_material_inference :
    810 ≤ naclDissolutionAt20 ∧ naclDissolutionAt20 ≤ 820 ∧
    -9 ≤ naclCapacityChange ∧ naclCapacityChange ≤ -8 := by
  norm_num [naclDissolutionAt20, naclCapacityChange, naclRelativeEnthalpy]

/- Physical answer for the chosen case: salt and room at 20 C;
   water+pot effective capacity C>=3900 J/K; atmospheric unsalted
   boiling B0 in [99,100.1] C, brine boiling B in [B0,101] C;

theorem nacl_immediate_addition_answer :
    ∀ (C W k B0 B x : ℝ),

      mixedTemperature C naclCapacityChange naclDissolutionAt20 20 x ≤ x) ∧
    (0 < netPower W k 20 x ∧
      netPower W k 20 x <
        netPower W k 20 (mixedTemperature C naclCapacityChange naclDissolutionAt20 20 x)) ∧
    boilingTime C naclCapacityChange naclDissolutionAt20 20 B W k 20 initialTemperature ≤
      boilingTime C naclCapacityChange naclDissolutionAt20 20 B W k 20 x := by
  intro C W k B0 B x hC hk hBlo hBhi hB hBmax hW hx
  obtain ⟨hHlo, hHhi, hSlo, hShi⟩ := nacl_material_inference
  have hc : 0 < C + naclCapacityChange := by linarith
  have hc0 : 0 < C := by linarith
  have hi : initialTemperature = 20 := rfl

    ⟨feasible.2.2.1, by linarith⟩, ?_⟩

import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Deriv
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.MeanValue
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

/- Supplied starting temperature in degrees Celsius. -/
def initialTemperature : ℝ := 20

/- Constant heater input W, room temperature A, linear heat-loss
   coefficient k. This SAME law applies to water and brine (watts). -/
def netPower (W k A T : ℝ) : ℝ := W - k * (T - A)

/- Instantaneous conservation of energy on adding salt: C is water+pot
   capacity, S = final solution capacity minus original water capacity (signed),
   Ts salt temperature and enthalpy reference, H dissolution energy at Ts. Capacities J/K, H joules. -/
noncomputable def mixedTemperature (C S H Ts x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (C * x + S * Ts - H) / (C + S)

/- Integrated inverse energy balance dt/dT = capacity/netPower(T).
   Used only where net power is positive and k>0. -/
noncomputable def heatingTime (capacity W k A u v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  capacity / k * (Real.log (netPower W k A u) - Real.log (netPower W k A v))

/- Total seconds to a fixed final solution boiling temperature B when
   salt is added at unsalted temperature x. The mixing temperature jump and the
   changed heat capacity are both included. -/
noncomputable def boilingTime (C S H Ts B W k A x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  heatingTime C W k A initialTemperature x +
  heatingTime (C + S) W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) B

/- H is the isothermal dissolution energy at Ts, not at every x.
   If cs is solid salt capacity, Kirchhoff gives dissolution energy
   H+(S-cs)*(x-Ts) at x. Warming the solid to x costs cs*(x-Ts).
   Thus their sum is H+S*(x-Ts), for either sign of S. -/
lemma reference_consistent_balance :
    ∀ (C S H Ts cs x z : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 →
    ((C + S) * (z - x) + cs * (x - Ts) +
      (H + (S - cs) * (x - Ts)) = 0 ↔
      z = mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) := by
  intro C S H Ts cs x z hc
  unfold mixedTemperature
  rw [eq_div_iff hc]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith

/- Derived conservation of enthalpy; no presumed mixing-temperature sign. -/
lemma mixing_balance :
    ∀ (C S H Ts x : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 →
    (C + S) * mixedTemperature C S H Ts x = C * x + S * Ts - H := by
  intro C S H Ts x hc
  unfold mixedTemperature
  field_simp

/- Derive the net-power jump from energy conservation AND the shared
   heat-transfer law; before/after powers are not independent parameters. -/
lemma power_change :
    ∀ (C S H Ts W k A x : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 →
    netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) - netPower W k A x =
      k * (S * (x - Ts) + H) / (C + S) := by
  intro C S H Ts W k A x hc
  unfold netPower mixedTemperature
  field_simp
  ring

lemma power_derivative :
    ∀ (W k A x : ℝ), HasDerivAt (netPower W k A) (-k) x := by
  intro W k A x
  unfold netPower
  convert (((hasDerivAt_id x).sub_const A).const_mul k).const_sub W using 1 <;> simp

/- Checks the integrated heating law against the differential first law:
   increasing endpoint temperature costs capacity/netPower seconds/K. -/
lemma heating_time_derivative :
    ∀ (capacity W k A u v : ℝ), k ≠ 0 → netPower W k A v ≠ 0 →
    HasDerivAt (fun y => heatingTime capacity W k A u y)
      (capacity / netPower W k A v) v := by
  intro capacity W k A u v hk hv
  have h := (((power_derivative W k A v).log hv).const_sub
    (Real.log (netPower W k A u))).const_mul (capacity / k)
  unfold heatingTime
  convert h using 1
  field_simp [hk, hv]

/- Derivation of the stage-time formula from the inverse first law.
   For any elapsed-time curve f with df/dT = capacity/netPower and f(u)=0,
   the endpoint time MUST equal heatingTime; it is not a fitted formula.
   Endpoint derivatives may be read as those of a smooth local extension. -/
lemma stage_time_from_energy :
    ∀ (capacity W k A u v : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ),

  have mono : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ),

    intro g hg
    apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Icc _ _)
    · intro y hy
      exact (hg y hy).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · intro y hy
      exact (hg y (interior_subset hy)).hasDerivWithinAt
    · intro y hy

      HasDerivAt (fun w => f w - heatingTime capacity W k A u w) 0 y := by

    intro y hy

  have hge := hn ⟨le_refl u, huv⟩ ⟨huv, le_refl v⟩ huv

    simp only [heatingTime, sub_self, mul_zero]

/- Eliminate the two heating stages. The derivative compares the time
   spent heating unsalted water with the time saved in the salted stage. -/
lemma boiling_time_derivative :
    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A x : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 → k ≠ 0 →
    netPower W k A x ≠ 0 →
    netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) ≠ 0 →

    unfold mixedTemperature
    convert ((((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul C).add_const (S * Ts)).sub_const H).div_const
      (C + S) using 1 <;> simp
  have hn := (power_derivative W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x)).comp x hm
  have hpost := (((hn.log hz).sub_const
    (Real.log (netPower W k A B))).const_mul ((C + S) / k))
  have hpre := heating_time_derivative C W k A initialTemperature x hk hx
  convert hpre.add hpost using 1
  · rfl
  · dsimp only [Function.comp_apply]
    field_simp [hc, hk, hx, hz]
    ring

/- The derivative has precisely the sign of the net cooling energy
   D(x)=S*(x-Ts)+H when capacities and net powers are positive. -/
lemma timing_derivative_signed :
    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A x : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 → k ≠ 0 →
    netPower W k A x ≠ 0 →
    netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) ≠ 0 →
    HasDerivAt (boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A)

      C * (k * (S * (x - Ts) + H) / (C + S)) /
        (netPower W k A x * netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x)) := by
    rw [← hj]
    field_simp
    <;> ring

/- Constant-capacity mixing is increasing in the addition temperature,
   even if S<0. Endpoint constraints keep the entire trajectory liquid.
   F is a common liquid lower bound; B0 is unsalted boiling temperature. -/
lemma feasible_trajectory :
    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A F B0 L U y : ℝ),

    F ≤ initialTemperature → initialTemperature ≤ L → L ≤ U → U ≤ B0 →

lemma time_decreasing_on_warming :
    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A u v : ℝ),

    intro y hy

/- Concrete scenario: 10 g crystalline NaCl at 20 C. Molar mass 58.443
   g/mol (NIST); solvent mass .99820675 kg from 1 L and NIST density.
   PI(con) v and q are linearly interpolated between the published .15
   and .20 mol/kg entries. This is an empirical interpolation, not new data.
   Result: relative apparent molar enthalpy, J/mol, Kelvin used in T². -/
noncomputable def naclRelativeEnthalpy (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let m : ℝ := 10 / (58.443 * 0.99820675)
  let f := (m - 0.15) / 0.05
  let v := (-0.8329 + f * 0.7802) / 1000
  let q := (-60.2 - f * 13.3) / 1000000;
  -(t + 273.15)^2 * (v + 2 * q * t)

/- Integral dissolution energy, joules, at the actual salt/reference
   temperature 20 C. Interpolate Criss-Cobble's 19.97 and 25 C standard
   solid-dissolution data, THEN add the same-temperature relative term. -/
noncomputable def naclDissolutionAt20 : ℝ :=
  (10 / 58.443) *
    (4481 - (20 - 19.97) * 657 / (25 - 19.97) + naclRelativeEnthalpy 20)

/- Effective constant solution-minus-water capacity, J/K, inferred as
   the 20-to-100 C SECANT of the apparent enthalpy with solid salt fixed
   at 20 C. It is NOT the local heat capacity at 25 C.
   Extend the last measured standard-dissolution segment (84.98,95.18 C)
   linearly to 100 C; add solid sensible heat 51 J/(mol K) * 80 K and
   the finite-concentration correction. These extensions/approximations
   are explicit empirical scenario choices, not certified error bounds. -/
noncomputable def naclCapacityChange : ℝ :=
  ((10 / 58.443) *
    (-4540 - (100 - 95.18) * 1318 / (95.18 - 84.98) +
      51 * (100 - 20) + naclRelativeEnthalpy 100) - naclDissolutionAt20) / 80

   change; these follow from the stated data and interpolation model. -/
lemma nacl_material_inference :
    810 ≤ naclDissolutionAt20 ∧ naclDissolutionAt20 ≤ 820 ∧
    -9 ≤ naclCapacityChange ∧ naclCapacityChange ≤ -8 := by
  norm_num [naclDissolutionAt20, naclCapacityChange, naclRelativeEnthalpy]

import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Deriv
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.MeanValue
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

/- Supplied starting temperature in degrees Celsius. -/
def initialTemperature : ℝ := 20

/- Constant heater input W, room temperature A, linear heat-loss
   coefficient k. This SAME law applies to water and brine (watts). -/
def netPower (W k A T : ℝ) : ℝ := W - k * (T - A)

/- Instantaneous conservation of energy on adding salt: C is water+pot
   capacity, S = final solution capacity minus original water capacity (signed),
   Ts salt temperature and enthalpy reference, H dissolution energy at Ts. Capacities J/K, H joules. -/
noncomputable def mixedTemperature (C S H Ts x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (C * x + S * Ts - H) / (C + S)

/- Integrated inverse energy balance dt/dT = capacity/netPower(T).
   Used only where net power is positive and k>0. -/
noncomputable def heatingTime (capacity W k A u v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  capacity / k * (Real.log (netPower W k A u) - Real.log (netPower W k A v))

/- Total seconds to a fixed final solution boiling temperature B when
   salt is added at unsalted temperature x. The mixing temperature jump and the
   changed heat capacity are both included. -/
noncomputable def boilingTime (C S H Ts B W k A x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  heatingTime C W k A initialTemperature x +
  heatingTime (C + S) W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) B

/- H is the isothermal dissolution energy at Ts, not at every x.
   If cs is solid salt capacity, Kirchhoff gives dissolution energy
   H+(S-cs)*(x-Ts) at x. Warming the solid to x costs cs*(x-Ts).
   Thus their sum is H+S*(x-Ts), for either sign of S. -/
lemma reference_consistent_balance :
    ∀ (C S H Ts cs x z : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 →
    ((C + S) * (z - x) + cs * (x - Ts) +
      (H + (S - cs) * (x - Ts)) = 0 ↔
      z = mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) := by
  intro C S H Ts cs x z hc
  unfold mixedTemperature
  rw [eq_div_iff hc]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith

/- Derived conservation of enthalpy; no presumed mixing-temperature sign. -/
lemma mixing_balance :
    ∀ (C S H Ts x : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 →
    (C + S) * mixedTemperature C S H Ts x = C * x + S * Ts - H := by
  intro C S H Ts x hc
  unfold mixedTemperature
  field_simp

/- Derive the net-power jump from energy conservation AND the shared
   heat-transfer law; before/after powers are not independent parameters. -/
lemma power_change :
    ∀ (C S H Ts W k A x : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 →
    netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) - netPower W k A x =
      k * (S * (x - Ts) + H) / (C + S) := by
  intro C S H Ts W k A x hc
  unfold netPower mixedTemperature
  field_simp
  ring

lemma power_derivative :
    ∀ (W k A x : ℝ), HasDerivAt (netPower W k A) (-k) x := by
  intro W k A x
  unfold netPower
  convert (((hasDerivAt_id x).sub_const A).const_mul k).const_sub W using 1 <;> simp

/- Checks the integrated heating law against the differential first law:
   increasing endpoint temperature costs capacity/netPower seconds/K. -/
lemma heating_time_derivative :
    ∀ (capacity W k A u v : ℝ), k ≠ 0 → netPower W k A v ≠ 0 →
    HasDerivAt (fun y => heatingTime capacity W k A u y)
      (capacity / netPower W k A v) v := by
  intro capacity W k A u v hk hv
  have h := (((power_derivative W k A v).log hv).const_sub
    (Real.log (netPower W k A u))).const_mul (capacity / k)
  unfold heatingTime
  convert h using 1
  field_simp [hk, hv]

/- Derivation of the stage-time formula from the inverse first law.
   For any elapsed-time curve f with df/dT = capacity/netPower and f(u)=0,
   the endpoint time MUST equal heatingTime; it is not a fitted formula.
   Endpoint derivatives may be read as those of a smooth local extension. -/
lemma stage_time_from_energy :
    ∀ (capacity W k A u v : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ),
    u ≤ v → k ≠ 0 →
    (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc u v, 0 < netPower W k A y) →

    intro g hg
    apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Icc _ _)
    · intro y hy
      exact (hg y hy).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · intro y hy
      exact (hg y (interior_subset hy)).hasDerivWithinAt
    · intro y hy

    simp only [heatingTime, sub_self, mul_zero]

/- Eliminate the two heating stages. The derivative compares the time
   spent heating unsalted water with the time saved in the salted stage. -/
lemma boiling_time_derivative :
    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A x : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 → k ≠ 0 →
    netPower W k A x ≠ 0 →
    netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) ≠ 0 →

    unfold mixedTemperature

      (C + S) using 1 <;> simp
  have hn := (power_derivative W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x)).comp x hm
  have hpost := (((hn.log hz).sub_const
    (Real.log (netPower W k A B))).const_mul ((C + S) / k))
  have hpre := heating_time_derivative C W k A initialTemperature x hk hx
  convert hpre.add hpost using 1
  · rfl
  · dsimp only [Function.comp_apply]
    field_simp [hc, hk, hx, hz]
    ring

/- The derivative has precisely the sign of the net cooling energy
   D(x)=S*(x-Ts)+H when capacities and net powers are positive. -/
lemma timing_derivative_signed :
    ∀ (C S H Ts B W k A x : ℝ), C + S ≠ 0 → k ≠ 0 →
    netPower W k A x ≠ 0 →
    netPower W k A (mixedTemperature C S H Ts x) ≠ 0 →
    HasDerivAt (boilingTime C S H Ts B W k A)

    rw [← hj]
    field_simp

import Mathlib.Basic.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

/- Supplied initial water temperature, in degrees Celsius. -/
def initialTemperature : ℝ := 20

/- A schedule: water temperature x just before salt addition (deg C),
   elapsed addition time a (s), mixed temperature z (deg C), and first
   arrival at the final solution boiling temperature at time t (s). -/
structure HeatingRun where
  x : ℝ
  a : ℝ
  z : ℝ
  t : ℝ

/- C is water plus pot heat capacity, S the added salt's effective heat
   capacity (J/K), H the dissolution heat cost (J, positive for endothermic),
   Ts the salt's initial temperature, B the final boiling temperature.
   P and Q are constant NET heating powers before and after addition (W).
   The three equalities express heating, instantaneous mixing/dissolution,
   and subsequent heating, respectively. No evaporation or phase change
   occurs before the endpoint; that is an applicability assumption.
   The inequalities ensure forward times and heating to the endpoint. -/
def HeatBalance (C S H Ts B P Q : ℝ) (r : HeatingRun) : Prop :=
  initialTemperature ≤ r.x ∧ 0 ≤ r.a ∧ r.a ≤ r.t ∧ r.z ≤ B ∧
  P * r.a = C * (r.x - initialTemperature) ∧
  (C + S) * r.z = C * r.x + S * Ts - H ∧
  Q * (r.t - r.a) = (C + S) * (B - r.z)

/- Eliminate the unobserved mixing temperature and addition time from
   energy conservation; this is derived, not an assumed timing formula. -/
lemma time_from_balance :
    ∀ (C S H Ts B P Q : ℝ) (r : HeatingRun),
    0 < P → 0 < Q → HeatBalance C S H Ts B P Q r →
    r.t = C * (r.x - initialTemperature) / P +
      ((C + S) * B - C * r.x - S * Ts + H) / Q := by
  intro C S H Ts B P Q r hP hQ hr
  rcases hr with ⟨_, _, _, _, hpre, hmix, hpost⟩
  have he : Q * r.t = Q * r.a + (C + S) * B - C * r.x - S * Ts + H := by
    nlinarith [hmix, hpost]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hP, ne_of_gt hQ]
  nlinarith [congrArg (fun v : ℝ => P * v) he,
    congrArg (fun v : ℝ => Q * v) hpre]

/- Scientific conclusion: for two admissible addition temperatures x<y,
   later addition takes longer exactly when the salted stage heats faster;
   it takes less time exactly when that stage heats slower. Equal powers
   give equal completion times and the stated common energy/power time.
   All parameters are left symbolic: the observations do not fit them. -/
theorem addition_timing_answer :
    ∀ (C S H Ts B P Q : ℝ) (r s : HeatingRun),
    0 < C → 0 ≤ S → 0 < P → 0 < Q →
    HeatBalance C S H Ts B P Q r →
    HeatBalance C S H Ts B P Q s → r.x < s.x →
    (r.t < s.t ↔ P < Q) ∧
    (s.t < r.t ↔ Q < P) ∧
    (s.t = r.t ↔ Q = P) ∧
    (Q = P → r.t = ((C + S) * B - C * initialTemperature - S * Ts + H) / P) := by
  intro C S H Ts B P Q r s hC hS hP hQ hr hs hxy
  have hd : 0 < C * (s.x - r.x) := mul_pos hC (sub_pos.mpr hxy)
  have hpq : 0 < P * Q := mul_pos hP hQ
  have hid : P * Q * (s.t - r.t) = C * (s.x - r.x) * (Q - P) := by
    rw [time_from_balance C S H Ts B P Q s hP hQ hs,
      time_from_balance C S H Ts B P Q r hP hQ hr]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hP, ne_of_gt hQ]
    <;> ring
  have hforward : (0 < s.t - r.t ↔ 0 < Q - P) := by
    calc
      0 < s.t - r.t ↔ 0 < P * Q * (s.t - r.t) :=
        (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hpq).symm
      _ ↔ 0 < C * (s.x - r.x) * (Q - P) := by rw [hid]
      _ ↔ 0 < Q - P := mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hd
  have hrev : P * Q * (r.t - s.t) = C * (s.x - r.x) * (P - Q) := by
    nlinarith [hid]
  have hback : (0 < r.t - s.t ↔ 0 < P - Q) := by
    calc
      0 < r.t - s.t ↔ 0 < P * Q * (r.t - s.t) :=
        (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hpq).symm
      _ ↔ 0 < C * (s.x - r.x) * (P - Q) := by rw [hrev]
      _ ↔ 0 < P - Q := mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hd
  refine ⟨sub_pos.symm.trans (hforward.trans sub_pos),
    sub_pos.symm.trans (hback.trans sub_pos), ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    · intro ht
      have hz : C * (s.x - r.x) * (Q - P) = 0 := by
        rw [← hid, ht]
        ring
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hz with hz | hz
      · exact False.elim ((ne_of_gt hd) hz)
      · linarith
    · intro heq
      have hz : P * Q * (s.t - r.t) = 0 := by
        rw [hid, heq]
        ring
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hz with hz | hz
      · exact False.elim ((ne_of_gt hpq) hz)
      · linarith
  · intro heq
    rw [time_from_balance C S H Ts B P Q r hP hQ hr, heq]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hP, ne_of_gt hQ]
    <;> ring
